title: dryopteris lanceola
intro: Dryopteris lanceola, commonly known as the Lance-leaved Wood Fern, is a species of fern native to North America. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris lanceola include acting as an expectorant, diuretic, and anti-edema agent, making it useful in treating bronchitis, asthma, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
